caption: The drawing consists of a single central object depicted on a plain, off-white background. The central object appears to be a sculptural or carved relief, resembling an oval medallion or plaque. Mounted on this oval base is the form of a bird, facing toward the right side of the image. The bird is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and white, giving it a mottled, naturalistic appearance. Surrounding the bird and partially overlaying the base are clusters of green leaves rendered in varying shades of green, suggesting foliage. The oval base itself is colored brown with some inscribed or carved designs along its edge. Below the central object, the word "Luten" is handwritten in small, brownish letters. The rest of the background remains blank and unadorned, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Door Knocker
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
